blocks.text: Lamphouse reduces the welcome of an inhabited place to a window and a light. The object recalls ordinary shelter and company rather than a lost ruler or a fragment of an ancient person.
A tiny crooked terracotta house fragment with a floating blue window shutter and warm cream interior.
One-shot activation: The floating shutter opens and a soft ribbon of warm light unrolls from the window. The game performs the final fade.
18 silver. Stress severity −2; reaching zero clears the condition. Health +6; Happiness +8. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes.

Original PixelLab artwork and opening animation, October 28, 2026. Generation e715aa61-8b49-4c44-affd-00095ff48f15; animation b4f58877-479e-4a9e-923a-68f8578fe5bf. The game performs the final fade; reduced motion holds a still.
